arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Monthly net receipts for Customs (tariff) for 1974 (in millions)
values = [304, 239, 277, 286, 295, 301, 325, 355, 305, 347, 319, 307]

# Calculate population standard deviation
n = len(values)
mean = sum(values) / n

# Population variance (using N, not N-1)
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in values) / n
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)

# Coefficient of Variation (CV)
cv = (std_dev / mean) * 100

print(f"Values: {values}")
print(f"N = {n}")
print(f"Mean = {mean}")
print(f"Population Std Dev = {std_dev}")
print(f"CV = {cv}%")
print(f"Rounded to hundredths: {cv:.2f}%")
EOF
